projects.name: Oklahoma data center campus
projects.quote: New 1.6GW data center campus in Oklahoma o Increases secured grid-connected power to >4.5GW o Grid-studies complete, with power scheduled to ramp from 2028 o Large scale site (2,000 acres) with low latency network connectivity
